messages.subject: Project Quartz — engagement and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Eleanor,

Thank you for asking us to act on the proposed licence of the AB-COAT(TM) patent family to Brandt Packaging Solutions. I attach our engagement letter setting out scope, team and fee estimate (£85k-£110k plus VAT). James Osei and Elena Marchetti will support me.

To get started we'll need: (i) the AML/client ID form completed; (ii) Hartington IP's contact for patent status; and (iii) any existing third-party arrangements touching the patents (you mentioned an evaluation licence). Could you also confirm the indicative commercial terms you have discussed with Brandt so we can prepare a term sheet?

Kind regards,
Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Quartz — engagement and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Signed engagement letter to follow from Priya. Indicative terms with Brandt: exclusive in compostable flexible packaging, Europe, £1.5m upfront and around 6.5% royalty. There is one legacy evaluation licence with Verdant Packaging Trials that runs to March 2026 - we need to protect that. Marcus (CTO) is your technical contact and owns the formulations.

Thanks,
Eleanor
